With the command-line interface (CLI) you can interact with the Vercel platform using a terminal, or through an automated system, enabling you to <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/cli/logs">retrieve logs</a>, manage <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/cli/certs">certificates</a>, replicate your deployment environment <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/cli/dev">locally</a>, manage Domain Name System (DNS) <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/cli/dns">records</a>, and more.</p>
<p class="my-4">If you'd like to interface with the platform programmatically, check out the <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/rest-api">REST API documentation</a>.</p>

<p class="my-4">Vercel CLI requires you to log in and authenticate before accessing resources or performing administrative tasks. In a terminal environment, you can use <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/cli/login"><code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">vercel login</code></a>, which requires manual input. In a CI/CD environment where manual input is not possible, you can create a token on your <a href="/account/tokens" data-zone="2d9dc9" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend">tokens page</a> and then authenticate using one of these methods:</p>
<ul class="my-3 list-disc pl-6 [&>li::marker]:text-gray-500">
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Set the <code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">VERCEL_TOKEN</code> environment variable</li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Pass the <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/cli/global-options#token"><code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">--token</code> option</a> to the command</li>
</ul>
<p class="my-4">Using the <code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">VERCEL_TOKEN</code> environment variable is recommended for CI/CD because it avoids exposing the token in command-line arguments, which can be visible in process lists and logs. If both are provided, the <code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">--token</code> flag takes precedence over the environment variable.</p>
